triangulationIntent: Test functional-behavior recurrence across manufacturers — not component-list universality.

domainTriangulation.lgR1Behavior: Relay 2 >8V enable → transformer → capacitor → diode → magnetron → HV fuse; per-component Ω tests §10
domainTriangulation.samsungR2Behavior: Power relay contacts → transformer §4-1 → capacitor §4-3 → diode §4-4 → magnetron §4-2; per-component Ω tests
domainTriangulation.implementationDifference: Different relay naming (Relay 2/D35 vs power relay); different transformer Ω bands — same diagnostic cascade structure

domainTriangulation.lgR1Behavior: Primary + secondary COM–NO + monitor COM–NC sequential §9-2
domainTriangulation.samsungR2Behavior: Primary + monitor + secondary + door-sensing §4-6 continuity table
domainTriangulation.implementationDifference: Samsung adds door-sensing switch for vent/HV gating — same monitor-chain safety contract

domainTriangulation.lgR1Behavior: Turntable motor 2.5–3.5 kΩ; waveguide/gasket on magnetron replace
domainTriangulation.samsungR2Behavior: Turntable harness/motor/RY206; magnetron filament test with cavity coupling
domainTriangulation.implementationDifference: LG has Ω spec on turntable; Samsung operational-first — same cavity field uniformity domain

domainTriangulation.lgR1Behavior: Single TCO TAB1–TAB2 on no-heat + PCB thermistor F-1/F-2 self-test
domainTriangulation.samsungR2Behavior: Four TCO types §4-8 + magnetron TCO on no-heat + C-20 temp sensor
domainTriangulation.implementationDifference: Samsung materially richer TCO network — same protection/sensing functional class, broader than range thermal_protection
domainTriangulation.triangulationVerdict: CROSS_MANUFACTURER_THERMAL_NETWORK — eventual graph must absorb multi-TCO not single fuse semantics

domainTriangulation.lgR1Behavior: Humidity F-4 + PCB cabinet thermistor F-1/F-2
domainTriangulation.samsungR2Behavior: Humidity C-10 quick test + C-20 temp sensor + split PCB C-F0/C-F1
domainTriangulation.implementationDifference: Different code families and sensor placement — shared cook-control sensing domain
domainTriangulation.triangulationVerdict: PARTIAL_RECURRENCE — platform vocabulary heavy; not reason to fit existing cooking contracts

domainTriangulation.lgR1Behavior: Referenced on TCO replace only — no dedicated procedure in R1
domainTriangulation.implementationDifference: R2 provides evidence LG R1 deferred — OTR ventilation is real functional layer

crossManufacturerSummary.workingHypothesis: Microwave requires its own functional contract broader than either implementation individually — discovery/freeze gate still required before microwave.json
